definition.reference_event: rule-valid main maneuver, standardized ICAO callsign, probable controller role, and nearest same-callsign trajectory point within the configured window
definition.time_alignment: VAD filename is Asia/Shanghai local time; parquet is UTC; association uses epoch seconds

parameters.snapshot_scope: all trajectories in the parquet sector-context window

warnings: speaker_role_rule is heuristic and is not equivalent to controller-verified labeling
association coverage is not controller-imitation accuracy
state snapshots are event-context audit artifacts, not a model invocation schedule
continuous shadow replay must invoke the system on every independent 4-second tick
the initial rule parser covers the Chinese-language subset; English radiotelephony remains out of scope
